verdict.rationale: Warp's docs say you can click a file path in terminal output or an AI conversation and open it in Warp's built-in editor, which covers the click-to-open-file-path core of the story. Nothing in the evidence covers opening URLs from output or selecting links or paths with the keyboard. missing for 10: clickable URL support in output, keyboard-driven selection/opening of links or paths, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open URLs and file paths from output by clicking them or selecting them from the keyboard

citations.quote: Click a file path from the terminal output or an AI conversation and select "Open in Warp."
